S10215.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

WP1003605.en: Iron Lamellar Heart Guard Armor - II

short.zh: 对统率类话题感兴趣，并喜欢参与沙盘战。
short.en: They are interested in LEA Topics and enjoy participating in War Games.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用统率话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用统率话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其统率值获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得统率话题。

◆进行沙盘战并在历史首次取胜时可使其叠加【敬畏】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using Leadership Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using Leadership Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their LEA.◆Higher Chance to obtain Leadership Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Winning a War Game against them for the first time ever can grant them a stack of the 【Awe】 state.

short.zh: 对武力类话题感兴趣，并喜欢参与武艺切磋。
short.en: They are interested in STR Topics and enjoy participating in sparring.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用武力话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用武力话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其武力获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得武力话题。

◆进行武艺切磋并在历史首次取胜时可使其叠加【敬畏】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using STR Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using STR Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their STR.◆Higher Chance to obtain STR Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Winning a sparring match against them for the first time ever can grant them a stack of the 【Awe】 state.

short.zh: 对智略类话题感兴趣，并喜欢参与辩论切磋。
short.en: They are interested in Intelligence Topics and enjoy participating in debate contests.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用智略话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用智略话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其智略获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得智略话题。

◆进行辩论切磋并在历史首次取胜时可使其叠加【敬畏】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using Intelligence Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using Intelligence Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their INT.◆Higher Chance to obtain Intelligence Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Winning a debate contest against them for the first time ever can grant them a stack of the 【Awe】 state.

short.zh: 对饮酒类话题感兴趣，与其进行饮酒话题总是能有些收获。
short.en: They are interested in Drinking Topics, discussing Drinking Topics with them always yields some reward.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用饮酒话题时获得的关系值和认同值提高50%。

◆关系等级不足2级时，也不会拒绝请喝酒的要求，请喝酒时获得的关系值和双方的心情提高30%。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得饮酒话题。

◆使用饮酒话题或请喝酒时有概率使其叠加【激发】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Approval gained from using Drinking Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆They will not refuse invitations to Drink even when Relationship level is below Level 2, Relationship Score gained and Mood of both parties from inviting them to Drink are increased by 30%.◆Higher Chance to obtain Drinking Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Using Drinking Topics or inviting them to Drink has a Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Roused】 state.

short.zh: 对饮酒类话题持反对看法，最好不要与其谈论相关内容。
short.en: They hold a negative view of Alcohol Topics, it is best not to discuss such matters with them.

desc.zh:
◆请喝酒时，必然会拒绝，

◆对其使用饮酒话题时，完全无效。
desc.en: ◆They will always refuse when invited to Drink,◆Drinking Topics used on them are completely ineffective.

short.zh: 对情色类话题感兴趣，与其进行情色话题总是能有些收获。
short.en: They are interested in Erotic Topics, discussing Erotic Topics with them always yields some reward.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用情色话题时获得的关系值和认同值提高100%。

◆提案使其成为情人时，总关系值的阈值下降200点。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得情色话题。

◆使用情色话题时有概率使其叠加【激发】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Approval gained from using Erotic Topics on them are increased by 100%.◆When making a Proposal to make them a Lover, the Total Relationship Score threshold is reduced by 200 points.◆Higher Chance to obtain Erotic Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Using Erotic Topics has a Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Roused】 state.

short.zh: 对娱乐类话题感兴趣，并对斗鸡比赛乐此不疲。
short.en: Interested in Recreation topics, and never tires of Cockfighting.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用娱乐话题时获得的关系值和认同值提高60%。

◆关系等级不足2级时，也不会拒绝斗鸡的要求，斗鸡时获得的关系值和双方的心情提高30%。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得娱乐话题。

◆使用娱乐话题或斗鸡时有概率使其叠加【激发】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Approval gained from using Entertainment Topics on them are increased by 60%.◆They will not refuse invitations to Cockfighting even when Relationship level is below Level 2, Relationship Score gained and Mood of both parties during Cockfighting are increased by 30%.◆Higher Chance to obtain Entertainment Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Using Entertainment Topics or Cockfighting has a Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Roused】 state.

short.zh: 对各类奇珍有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其贵重物品之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a deep interest in rare treasures and will be grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who gifts them valuable items.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的贵重物品时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的贵重物品时，可使其社交兴趣+1。
desc.en: ◆When gifting valuable items of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting valuable items of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 对书籍有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其书籍之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a deep interest in Books and will be grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who gifts them Books.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的书籍时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的书籍时可以使其社交兴趣+1。。
desc.en: ◆When gifting Books of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting Books of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 对马匹有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其马匹之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a keen interest in Mounts and will be grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who gifts them Mounts.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的马匹时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的马匹时可以使其社交兴趣+1。
desc.en: ◆When gifting Mounts of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting Mounts of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 对武具有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其武具之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a strong passion for weapons, feeling deeply grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who presents them with arms.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的武具时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的武具时可以使其社交兴趣+1。
desc.en: ◆When gifting weapons of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting weapons of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 对任何轻松的话题都有点兴趣，较容易拉近与他人关系。
short.en: Has some interest in any casual Topic, making it easier to build rapport with others.

desc.zh: ◆对其使用任何轻松类话题都可根据话题效果叠加[激发]效果。
desc.en: ◆Using any casual Topic on them stacks the [Roused] effect according to the Topic's effect.

short.zh: 对他人心怀感激，可更快地提高与其的感恩值。
short.en: They are Grateful toward others, Gratitude with them increases more quickly.

desc.zh:
◆感恩值上限为300

◆感恩值提高时，其增加幅度提高50%
desc.en: ◆Maximum Gratitude is 300◆When Gratitude increases, the amount gained is increased by 50%

short.zh: 内心淡漠，难以对他人的给予产生感恩之情。
short.en: They are Aloof at heart and find it difficult to feel Grateful for what others give.

desc.zh:
◆感恩值上限为100

◆感恩值提高时，其增加幅度降低50%
desc.en: ◆Maximum Gratitude is 100◆When Gratitude increases, the amount gained is reduced by 50%

short.zh: 瑕疵必报，对冒犯之人增加更多的仇恨值。
short.en: They are vindictive and petty, accumulating far more Hatred toward those who offend them.

desc.zh: ◆仇恨值提高（感恩降低）时，其变化幅度提高100%
desc.en: ◆When Hatred increases (Grateful decreases), the amount of change is increased by 100%

short.zh: 对才华横溢之人心怀尊重，可更快地提高与其的尊重值。
short.en: They hold great Respect for the exceptionally talented, Respect with them can be raised more quickly.

desc.zh:
◆尊重值的上限为300

◆尊重值提高时，其增加幅度提高50%
desc.en: ◆Maximum Respect is 300◆When Respect increases, the amount gained is increased by 50%

short.zh: 内心傲慢，难以对他人的才华产生尊重之情。
short.en: They are Arrogant at heart and find it difficult to feel Respect for others' talents.

desc.zh:
◆尊重值上限为100

◆尊重值提高时，其增加幅度降低50%
desc.en: ◆Respect cap is 100.◆When Respect increases, the amount gained is reduced by 50%.

short.zh: 心胸狭隘，容易嫉妒他人的才华，若与其关系值不高，还是低调行事为妙。
short.en: They are narrow-minded and prone to envying others' talents. If your Relationship Score with them is low, it is best to keep a low profile.

desc.zh: ◆在关系等级低于3时, 每当尊重值提高时, 50%概率不但不会上升，反而会下降同等的数值
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 3, whenever Respect would increase, there is a 50% Chance it will decrease by the same amount instead.

short.zh: 执着于自身所认同之事，若与其产生共鸣将增加更多的认同。
short.en: Clings to what they personally endorse, resonating with them grants additional Approval.

desc.zh:
◆认同值上限为300

◆认同值提高时，其增加幅度提高50%
desc.en: ◆Approval cap is 300◆When Approval increases, the amount gained is increased by 50%

short.zh: 对任何事都没有自己的看法，也难以明白他人的见解，很少完全认同他人。
short.en: They have no opinions of their own on anything and struggle to understand the views of others, rarely granting full Approval.

desc.zh:
◆认同值上限为100

◆认同值提高时，其增加幅度降低50%
desc.en: ◆Approval cap is 100.◆When Approval increases, the amount gained is reduced by 50%.

short.zh: 善于制造浪漫，建立亲密关系后，可更快速地提高与其的关系。
short.en: Adept at creating Romantic moments, after establishing a close relationship, your relationship with them improves more quickly.

desc.zh: ◆向其赠送小礼物或进行情话时，叠加【浪漫】状态的可能性增加15%。
desc.en: ◆When giving them small Gifts or speaking sweet talk to them, the Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Romantic】 state increases by 15%.

short.zh: 心系百姓之人，若想获得其认同与忠心，最好多行惠民之策。
short.en: They are devoted to the common people, to gain their Approval and loyalty, it is best to pursue Benevolent policies.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若你执行利于民众的政策, 则其忠诚度和认同值会提高，反之则会下降。

◆若你在执行工作时做出对民众有利的举动，则此人的认同值提升. 反之则下降。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, if you enact policies that benefit the people, their Loyalty and Approval will increase, conversely, they will decrease.◆If you take actions that benefit the people while performing your duties, this person's Approval will increase, conversely, it will decrease.

short.zh: 忽视百姓之人，若想获得其认同与忠心，需要对百姓多加制约。
short.en: They disregard the common people, gaining their Approval and loyalty requires keeping the populace under tight control.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若你执行剥削民众的政策, 则其忠诚度和认同值会提高，反之则会下降。

◆若你在执行工作时做出对剥削民众的举动，则此人的认同值提升. 反之则下降。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, if you enact policies that exploit the populace, their Loyalty and Approval will increase, conversely, they will decrease.◆If you commit acts that exploit the populace while performing your duties, this person's Approval will increase, conversely, it will decrease.

short.zh: 对任何轻松的话题都不会有反对意见，但话题带来的成效也会降低。
short.en: They will not object to any casual Topic, but the effects of Topics are also reduced.

desc.zh: ◆对其使用任何轻松类话题时都不会拒绝，并会提升少量认同值。
desc.en: ◆They will never refuse any casual Topic used on them, and they gain a small amount of Approval.

short.zh: 对其不感兴趣的轻松类话题难以认同，对其使用话题时需要多加注意。
short.en: They find it hard to show Approval for casual Topics that do not interest them, exercise caution when using Topics on them.

desc.zh: ◆对其使用没有对应性格的轻松类话题时，都不会有任何效果。
desc.en: ◆Casual Topics that do not match their Personality will have no effect whatsoever.

short.zh: 在战事当中偏向进攻之人，若想获得其认同，需要主动出击。
short.en: They favor offense in warfare, to gain their Approval, you must take the initiative to attack.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，每当势力进行攻城战时, 其忠诚度会提高2点，认同值提高6点。

◆反之每当进行守城战时，其忠诚度会下降1点，认同值降低4点。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, each time the Faction engages in Siege Battles, their Loyalty increases by 2 and Approval increases by 6.◆Conversely, each time the Faction engages in City Defense, their Loyalty decreases by 1 and Approval decreases by 4.

short.zh: 在战事当中偏向防守之人，若想获得其认同，需要善于防守。
short.en: They favor defense in warfare, to gain their Approval, you must be adept at defense.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，每当势力进行守城战时, 其忠诚度会提高3点，认同值提高6点。

◆反之每当进行攻城战时，其忠诚度会下降2点，认同值降低4点。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, every time the Faction engages in City Defense, their Loyalty increases by 3 and Approval increases by 6.◆Conversely, every time the Faction engages in Siege Battles, their Loyalty decreases by 2 and Approval decreases by 4.

short.zh: 为人刚正，若想获得其认同，最好多行公平正义之事。
short.en: They are upright and steadfast in character, to gain their Approval, it is best to act with justice and fairness.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若你执行有利公义的政策, 则其忠诚度和认同值会提高，反之则会下降。

◆若你在执行工作时做出有利公义的举动，且此人的认同值提升. 反之则下降。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, if you enact policies that benefit justice, their Loyalty and Approval will increase, conversely, they will decrease.◆If you take actions that benefit justice while performing your duties, this person's Approval will increase, conversely, it will decrease.

short.zh: 为人贪婪自私，若想获得其认同，最好多行腐败享乐之事。
short.en: They are Greedy and selfish by nature, to gain their Approval, it is best to indulge in corrupt and Playful pursuits.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若你执行有失公允的政策, 则其忠诚度和认同值会提高，反之则会下降。

◆若你在执行工作时做出贪污腐败的举动，且此人的认同值提升. 反之则下降。
desc.en: ◆When they serve under you and Relationship level is below Level 3, if you enact unjust policies, their Loyalty and Approval will increase, conversely, they will decrease.◆If you commit corrupt acts while performing your duties, this person's Approval will increase, conversely, it will decrease.

short.zh: 和平主义者，期望势力之间能够长期维持和平。
short.en: They are a Pacifist who hopes that long-lasting peace can be maintained between Factions.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若能保持一年以上的和平状态，则每个季度提高高3点忠诚度和6点认同值。

◆反之，若是保持连续两个季度都有战事发生（以开战时间计算），则从第二个季度开始，每个季度降低2点忠诚和4点认同。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, if peace is maintained for over one year, they gain 3 Loyalty and 6 Approval each quarter.◆Conversely, if battles occur for two consecutive quarters (calculated from the battle start time), starting from the second quarter, they lose 2 Loyalty and 4 Approval each quarter.

short.zh: 好战主义者，期望势力之间能够长期维持战争。
short.en: They are a Militant who hopes that long-lasting warfare can be maintained between Factions.

desc.zh:
◆当其在你麾下且关系等级不足3级时，若是保持连续两个季度都有战事发生（以开战时间计算），则从第二个季度开始，每个季度增加3点忠诚和6点认同。

◆反之，若是保持一年以上的和平状态，则每个季度会降低2点忠诚度和4点认同值。
desc.en: ◆When they are under your command and Relationship level is below Level 3, if battles occur for two consecutive quarters (calculated from the battle start time), starting from the second quarter, they gain 3 Loyalty and 6 Approval each quarter.◆Conversely, if peace is maintained for over one year, they lose 2 Loyalty and 4 Approval each quarter.

short.zh: 看中正邪，正邪不匹配时，社交将变得非常困难。
short.en: They place great value on Alignment, socializing becomes very difficult when your Alignment does not match theirs.

desc.zh: ◆如果关系等级不足3级，且正邪相悖，社交效果加成只有平时的60%。
desc.en: ◆If Relationship level is below Level 3 and your Alignment conflicts with theirs, the Social Effects bonus is reduced to 60% of normal.

short.zh: 重名之人，声望值越高则越容易拉近关系，若声望值过低则无法相处。
short.en: They value reputation, the higher your Renown, the easier it is to grow closer to them, but if your Renown is too low, getting along is impossible.

desc.zh: ◆关系等级不足3级时，比此人的声望高得越多，社交效果越佳，反之则降低。
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 3, the more your Renown exceeds this person's, the better the Social Effects, conversely, the lower your Renown, the more the effects are reduced.

short.zh: 重貌之人，魅力值越高则越容易拉近关系。
short.en: They are Looks-Driven, the higher your CHA, the easier it is to grow closer to them.

desc.zh: ◆关系等级不足3级时, 与其社交时，你的魅力加权比平时增加50%。
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 3, your CHA weighting is increased by 50% compared to normal when socializing with them.

short.zh: 为人内敛，对陌生人或一般的朋友不愿敞开心扉。
short.en: They are Reserved by nature, unwilling to open up to strangers or ordinary Friends.

desc.zh: ◆当关系等级不足3级时，每个季度初，社交兴趣的增加值-1。
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 3, Social Will gained at the start of each quarter is reduced by 1.

short.zh: 为人热枕，对陌生人有更多的社交兴趣。
short.en: They are warm and enthusiastic by nature and have more Social Will toward strangers.

desc.zh: ◆当关系等级不足2级时，每个季度初，社交兴趣的增加值+1。
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 2, the Social Will gained at the start of each quarter is increased by 1.

short.zh: 热爱交友，更容易与其成为朋友。
short.en: They love making friends, it is easier to become Friends with them.

desc.zh: ◆与其成为朋友的阈值降低50点。
desc.en: ◆The Relationship Score threshold to become Friends with them is reduced by 50 points.

short.zh: 为人小心谨慎，较难与其成为朋友。
short.en: They are cautious by nature, making it difficult to become Friends with them.

desc.zh: ◆与其成为朋友的阈值升高100点。
desc.en: ◆The Relationship Score threshold to become Friends with them is increased by 100 points.

short.zh: 交友更为真挚，虽然更不容易成为朋友，但对朋友也会更上心。
short.en: They are more Sincere in friendship, while it is harder to become Friends with them, they are far more devoted to their Friends.

desc.zh: ◆关系等级不足5级时，每次进阶关系时的阈值都会提高50点, 但突破阈值后,会增加20点关系值。
desc.en: ◆When Relationship level is below Level 5, the threshold for each Relationship level advancement is increased by 50 points, but once the threshold is broken through, Relationship Score increases by 20 points.

short.zh: 对政略类话题感兴趣。
short.en: Interested in POL Topics.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用政略话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用政略话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其政略获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得政略话题。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using Politics Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using Politics Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their POL.◆Higher Chance to obtain Politics Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.

short.zh: 对魅力类话题感兴趣。
short.en: They are interested in Charisma Topics.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用魅力话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用魅力话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其魅力获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得魅力话题。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using Charisma Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using Charisma Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their CHA.◆Higher Chance to obtain Charisma Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.

short.zh: 对意志类话题感兴趣。
short.en: They are interested in DET Topics.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用意志话题时获得的关系值和尊重值提高50%。

◆关系等级达到3级后，对其使用意志话题时，双方会根据总关系值和其意志获得更多经验值。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得意志话题。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Respect gained from using Determination Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Once Relationship level reaches Level 3, using Determination Topics on them grants both parties more EXP based on Total Relationship Score and their DET.◆Higher Chance to obtain Determination Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.

short.zh: 对旅游类话题、游历景区感兴趣，与其进行旅游话题总是能有些收获。
short.en: They are interested in Travel Topics and visiting Scenic Areas, discussing Travel Topics with them always yields some reward.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用旅游话题和时获得的关系值和认同值提高50%。

◆与其同游时获得的关系值提高30%。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得旅游话题。

◆使用旅游话题时有概率使其叠加【激发】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Approval gained from using Travel Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Relationship Score gained when traveling with them is increased by 30%.◆Higher Chance to obtain Travel Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Using Travel Topics has a Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Roused】 state.

short.zh: 对财富类话题感兴趣，与其进行财富话题总是能有些收获。
short.en: They are interested in wealth-related Topics, discussing Wealth Topics with them always yields some reward.

desc.zh:
◆对其使用财富话题时获得的关系值和认同值提高50%。

◆与其深谈时有更高概率获得财富话题。

◆使用财富话题时有概率使其叠加【激发】状态。
desc.en: ◆Relationship Score and Approval gained from using Wealth Topics on them are increased by 50%.◆Higher Chance to obtain Wealth Topics when engaging in Deep Talk with them.◆Using Wealth Topics has a Chance to grant them a stack of the 【Roused】 state.

short.zh: 做为伴侣时，每次与其谈心，总会令人如沐春风。
short.en: As a partner, every heart-to-heart with them feels like a gentle spring breeze.

desc.zh: ◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，则深谈，使用话题或情话时，获得的心情值增加50%。
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them, Mood gained from Deep Talk, Topics, or sweet talk is increased by 50%.

short.zh: 做为伴侣时，与其为伴时，双方的武魂点会缓慢提升。
short.en: When they are your companion, traveling with them slowly increases both parties' Martial SP.

desc.zh:
◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，且与其同行时，每个月双方的武魂点都会增加，增加值为总关系值/100

◆每次与其缠绵后，双方的武魂点增加，增加值为总关系值/200
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them and traveling in their party, both parties' Martial SP increases each month by Total Relationship Score / 100◆After each time you share intimacy with them, both parties' Martial SP increases by Total Relationship Score / 200

short.zh: 做为伴侣时，与其为伴时，精力会缓慢提高。
short.en: As a companion, accompanying them slowly restores Stamina.

desc.zh: ◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，且与其同行时，每天恢复2点精力值（与侍女的恢复无法叠加)。
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them and traveling in their party, you Recover 2 Stamina each day (this does not stack with the maid's recovery).

short.zh: 对防具有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其防具之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a keen interest in armor and will be grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who gifts them armor.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的防具时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的防具时可以使其社交兴趣+1。
desc.en: ◆When gifting armor of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting armor of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 对衣物有浓厚兴趣，会对赠送其衣物之人心存感激与交往倾向。
short.en: They have a keen interest in clothing and will be grateful and favorably disposed toward anyone who gifts them clothing.

desc.zh:
◆赠送等级合适的衣物时，增加的关系值和感恩值提高100%

◆赠送等级合适的衣物时可以使其社交兴趣+1。
desc.en: ◆When gifting clothing of an appropriate Level, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are increased by 100%◆Gifting clothing of an appropriate Level grants them +1 Social Will.

short.zh: 无欲无求，对赠送其物品之人心存较少的感恩之情。
short.en: They are Ascetic and free of desire, feeling less Grateful toward those who give them gifts.

desc.zh: ◆赠送礼物时提高的关系值与感恩值只有平时的50%
desc.en: ◆When giving Gifts, Relationship Score and Gratitude gained are only 50% of the normal amount

short.zh: 做为伴侣时，与其为伴时，双方的智魂点会缓慢提升。
short.en: When they are your companion, traveling with them slowly increases both parties' Mind SP.

desc.zh:
◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，且与其同行时，每个月双方智魂点都会增加，增加值为总关系值/100。

◆每次与其缠绵后，双方的智魂点增加，增加值为总关系值/200。
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them and traveling in their party, both parties' Mind SP increases each month by Total Relationship Score / 100.◆After each time you share intimacy with them, both parties' Mind SP increases by Total Relationship Score / 200.

short.zh: 做为伴侣时，与其为伴时，双方的军魂点会缓慢提升。
short.en: When they are your companion, traveling with them slowly increases both parties' Command SP.

desc.zh:
◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，且与其同行时，每个月双方军魂点都会增加，增加值为总关系值/100。

◆每次与其缠绵后，双方的军魂点增加，增加值为总关系值/200。
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them and traveling in their party, both parties' Command SP increases each month by Total Relationship Score / 100.◆After each time you share intimacy with them, both parties' Command SP increases by Total Relationship Score / 200.

short.zh: 与其更容易达成情人关系。
short.en: It is easier to become Lovers with them.

desc.zh: ◆提案使其成为情人时，总关系值的阈值下降200点。
desc.en: ◆When making a Proposal to make them a Lover, the Total Relationship Score threshold is reduced by 200 points.

short.zh: 及时行乐，享受当下，进行缠绵互动不需要其他约束。
short.en: They seek pleasure in the moment and enjoy the present, engaging in intimate interactions requires no other constraints.

desc.zh: ◆若与其为夫妻，恋人或情人关系，即便没有浪漫状态，也可以进行缠绵。
desc.en: ◆If you are in a Spouse, Beloved, or Lover relationship with them, you can share intimacy with them even without the Romantic state.

short.zh: 使其他同行武将每个月获得统率经验。
short.en: Grants other Party Officers LEA EXP each month.

desc.zh: 在同行队伍中时，所有其他同行武将每个月会获得统率经验值，统率差越大，获得的经验值越多。
desc.en: While in the Accompanying Party, all other Party Officers gain LEA EXP each month, the greater the LEA difference, the more EXP is gained.

short.zh: 使其他同行武将每个月获得武力经验。
short.en: Grants other Party Officers STR EXP each month.

desc.zh: 在同行队伍中时，所有其他同行武将每个月会获得武力经验值，武力差越大，获得的经验值越多。
desc.en: While in the Accompanying Party, all other Party Officers gain STR EXP each month, the greater the STR difference, the more EXP is gained.

desc.en: While in the Accompanying Party, all other Party Officers gain POL EXP each month, the greater the POL difference, the more EXP is gained.

desc.en: While in the Accompanying Party, all other Party Officers gain CHA EXP each month, the greater the CHA difference, the more EXP is gained.

desc.en: When in an Accompanying Party, all other Party Officers gain DET EXP each month, the greater the DET difference, the more EXP gained.
